svg.title: The raft goes where a basin is still empty
svg.desc: Five square basins step down and turn a corner. The middle one, at the corner, is full of teal water and carries a raft with two rows of seats. The floor of the next basin, still dry, is lit magenta; the gate between them has sunk and the water is starting to run through, taking the raft with it. The basins behind are dry.
